panels.description: In the ideal case, there are no incomplete events. If you start seeing incomplete events, make note of this in the ECL!
panels.title: Incomplete Events Released To Art From This Run

panels.description:
This panel should read 0 if the intended TPC boards are being read as expected. If one goes into the "busy" status, this box will turn red.

In this case, there is an issue.
panels.title: ALARM: TPC BoardReaders Busy

panels.description:
This shows the maximum circular buffer occupancy across the elements in the run.

If this box goes red then the circular buffers are acting outside of expected conditions.
panels.title: ALARM: TPC Circular Buffers Occupancy

panels.description:
This panel should read 0 if the intended PMT boards are being read as expected. If one goes into the "busy" status, this box will turn red.

In this case, there is an issue.
panels.title: ALARM: PMT Digitizers Busy

panels.description: Monitor for the internal temperature of the CAENV1730. It turns red when the temperature exceeds 65 degrees. A run should be stopped if this occurrence happens
panels.title: ALARM: PMT Temperatures

panels.description: total number empty fragments collected this run

panels.description:
Shows how much of the /scratch_local area on evb01 is being used.

It's set to go orange above 60%, meaning take note, and it's set to go red above 95%, meaning alarm.
panels.title: /scratch_local Usage Monitor

panels.description:
Shows how much of the /data area on evb01 is being used.

It's set to go orange above 60%, meaning take note, and it's set to go red above 95%, meaning alarm.
panels.title: /data Usage Monitor
